ddl:
CREATE TABLE Device (
    Device_Status VARCHAR(255),
    ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    IP_Address VARCHAR(255),
    Installation_Location VARCHAR(255),
    Installation_Time DATETIME,
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Type VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE User (
    ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    User_Account INTEGER,
    User_Password VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Staff (
    Contact_Information VARCHAR(255),
    ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Network_Traffic (
    Device_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Download_Traffic FLOAT,
    Timestamp INTEGER,
    Total_Traffic FLOAT,
    Traffic_Status VARCHAR(255),
    Upload_Traffic FLOAT,
    PRIMARY KEY (Device_ID, Timestamp),
    FOREIGN KEY (Device_ID) REFERENCES Device(ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Device_Failure_Record (
    Device_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Failure_Description VARCHAR(255),
    Failure_Occurrence_Time DATETIME,
    Failure_Type VARCHAR(255),
    Handling_Status VARCHAR(255),
    Remarks VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (Device_ID, Failure_Occurrence_Time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Device_ID) REFERENCES Device(ID)
);

CREATE TABLE User_Connection_Device (
    Connection_Time DATETIME,
    Device_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Disconnection_Time DATETIME,
    Used_Bandwidth FLOAT,
    User_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    User_IP VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (User_ID, Device_ID, Connection_Time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Device_ID) REFERENCES Device(ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (User_ID) REFERENCES User(ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Device_Maintenance_Record (
    Device_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Maintenance_Content VARCHAR(255),
    Maintenance_Result VARCHAR(255),
    Maintenance_Time DATETIME,
    Remarks VARCHAR(255),
    Staff_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Device_ID, Staff_ID, Maintenance_Time),
    FOREIGN KEY (Device_ID) REFERENCES Device(ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Staff_ID) REFERENCES Staff(ID)
);
gold_question:
The wireless network monitoring and device management system primarily functions to manage device information, record network traffic data, track device failures and maintenance status, and monitor user connections to devices. The system is also capable of tracking maintenance operations performed by staff on the devices. The database includes the following functions:

Device Management: record basic information of all network devices. Fields include Device ID, Name, Type, IP Address, Installation Location, Installation Time, and Device Status. 
 
User Management: store user account information. Fields include User ID, User Account, and User Password. 
 
Network traffic Management: record network traffic data of each device at specific time points. Fields include Device ID, Timestamp, Upload Traffic, Download Traffic, Total Traffic, and Traffic Status.  

Device failure record Management: record device failure information. Fields include Device ID, Failure Occurrence Time, Failure Type, Failure Description, Handling Status, and Remarks.  

Staff Management: record information about staff members. Fields include Staff ID, Name, and Contact Information.  

User connection device Management: record the connection status between users and devices. Fields include User ID, Device ID, Connection Time, Disconnection Time, Bandwidth Used, and User IP.  

Device maintenance record Management: Used to document device maintenance information. Fields include Device ID, Staff ID, Maintenance Time, Maintenance Content, Maintenance Result, and Remarks.  

The design of thus system is primarily for device management, network traffic monitoring, failure diagnosis and handling, tracking user connection status, and maintaining device maintenance records.
